resources.string: Searching sends this visit’s coordinates, a 1 km radius, language and place categories to Geoapify. Your journal history is not sent. Choosing a result replaces the name, address and coordinates in this draft; save the visit to keep it.
Nearby business search is not configured in this build.
Allow network geocoding in Settings to search nearby businesses.
This location has expired. Close this search and request a new location.
No nearby places were found. Try again or enter the place details yourself.
Nearby places could not be loaded. Try again.

Place search sends submitted text; country and address lookups can send coordinates to your device’s geocoding service. Nearby business searches send the selected visit coordinates, radius, language and place categories to Geoapify. Disabling network geocoding stops these lookups and country analysis; recording, offline pin selection and manual stays remain available.
